semantic_action: Replace composition with the selected deterministic template version
pointer_interaction: Open selector and choose an option
keyboard_interaction: Native select focus; Arrow keys choose; Enter/Space commits
disabled_condition: INITIALIZING, EXPORTING, or no registered templates
loading_state: Shows current template but is unavailable during initialization
error_state: Retains prior valid composition and announces failure
mobile_narrow_behavior: Remains directly available in the compact toolbar

semantic_action: Expose eligible dataset entities not visible in the composition
pointer_interaction: Scroll, select an entity, or begin palette drag
keyboard_interaction: Tab through named Drag and Add controls; Enter/Space on either adds without requiring drag
disabled_condition: INITIALIZING
loading_state: Uses a labeled busy state until dataset initialization completes
error_state: Shows a non-destructive status and retryable empty state
mobile_narrow_behavior: Collapsible panel/region; add buttons remain available

semantic_action: Reveal one existing dataset entity at a deterministic add position
pointer_interaction: Click/tap Add; drag row and drop on canvas
keyboard_interaction: Focus row Add button and press Enter/Space
disabled_condition: Entity ineligible, no longer in dataset, or interaction blocked by EXPORTING
loading_state: No per-row loading; disabled during initialization
error_state: Stale ID is rejected; composition is unchanged and status announced
mobile_narrow_behavior: Always present because drag is not required on touch

semantic_action: Reveal one existing dataset entity at the drop world coordinate
pointer_interaction: Primary-pointer drag; drop on canvas; Escape/pointer cancel aborts
keyboard_interaction: Not the sole add path; keyboard users use Palette entity Add
disabled_condition: Entity ineligible, already visible, or another interaction active
error_state: Invalid drop cancels without mutation and announces status
mobile_narrow_behavior: Touch Pointer Events supported; Add remains the preferred fallback

semantic_action: Filter only the displayed available-entity list; never filter the dataset/canvas
pointer_interaction: Focus field; type or clear query
keyboard_interaction: Native text editing; Escape clears query
disabled_condition: Control omitted when search is not implemented; otherwise INITIALIZING
error_state: Invalid input is treated as no matches without changing composition
mobile_narrow_behavior: If implemented, stays inside collapsible palette with visible Clear action

semantic_action: Restore the previous committed composition snapshot
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space; optional platform undo shortcut may mirror it
disabled_condition: Past history empty, INITIALIZING, or EXPORTING
error_state: Failure retains present snapshot and announces status
mobile_narrow_behavior: Remains in compact toolbar with accessible name

semantic_action: Restore the next committed composition snapshot
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space; optional platform redo shortcut may mirror it
disabled_condition: Future history empty, INITIALIZING, or EXPORTING
error_state: Failure retains present snapshot and announces status
mobile_narrow_behavior: Remains in compact toolbar with accessible name

semantic_action: Replace visible node positions with deterministic typed-lane layout
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space
disabled_condition: No visible nodes, INITIALIZING, NODE_DRAGGING, PANNING, or EXPORTING
error_state: Invalid layout result is rejected and prior positions retained
mobile_narrow_behavior: Remains available from compact toolbar/overflow without pointer precision

semantic_action: Fit all visible node bounds in the viewport with padding
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space
disabled_condition: No visible nodes or INITIALIZING
error_state: Invalid dimensions fall back to last finite viewport and announce status
mobile_narrow_behavior: Remains available in compact toolbar/overflow

semantic_action: Increase viewport zoom around its predictable center
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space
disabled_condition: At maximum zoom 2.5 or INITIALIZING
error_state: Invalid viewport is normalized to a safe finite value
mobile_narrow_behavior: Remains visible or in accessible overflow; touch target preserved

semantic_action: Decrease viewport zoom around its predictable center
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space
disabled_condition: At minimum zoom 0.35 or INITIALIZING
error_state: Invalid viewport is normalized to a safe finite value
mobile_narrow_behavior: Remains visible or in accessible overflow; touch target preserved

semantic_action: Restore the current template's default fitted viewport without changing composition
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space
disabled_condition: INITIALIZING
error_state: Fit failure retains the last finite viewport and announces status
mobile_narrow_behavior: Available from compact toolbar/overflow

semantic_action: Clear this workspace's local persistence and reapply the current template
pointer_interaction: Click/tap; use explicit confirmation if the UI supplies one
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space; confirmation is keyboard operable
disabled_condition: INITIALIZING or EXPORTING
loading_state: Brief busy/status state while local reset and reinitialization complete
error_state: Storage failure does not affect source data; in-memory template reset proceeds and is announced
mobile_narrow_behavior: Available from compact toolbar/overflow; wording stays Reset Canvas

semantic_action: Download canvas content only from a stable composition snapshot at default 2× scale
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space
disabled_condition: INITIALIZING, EXPORTING, or no visible content
loading_state: Button exposes busy/EXPORTING state and prevents duplicate activation
error_state: EXPORT_ERROR is announced; no partial download; retry remains available
mobile_narrow_behavior: Available from compact toolbar/overflow with text accessible name

semantic_action: Hide a visible non-root node from local composition
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space
disabled_condition: Root node, node no longer visible, INITIALIZING, or EXPORTING
error_state: Stale selection clears safely; dataset remains unchanged
mobile_narrow_behavior: Action remains available in inspector sheet; never labeled Delete

semantic_action: Clear the primary selection and dismiss item details
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space; Escape may invoke from inspector
disabled_condition: No selection/inspector already closed
error_state: Focus returns to canvas or invoking item
mobile_narrow_behavior: Closes inspector sheet and returns focus predictably

semantic_action: Toggle palette presentation without changing entity visibility
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space; exposes aria-expanded
disabled_condition: INITIALIZING only if the header is not yet mounted
error_state: Failure leaves prior expanded state
mobile_narrow_behavior: May default collapsed; reopening preserves palette context/filter

semantic_action: Toggle selected-item details without clearing selection
keyboard_interaction: Focus and press Enter/Space; exposes aria-expanded
disabled_condition: No selection or inspector unavailable
error_state: Failure leaves prior expanded state and selection
mobile_narrow_behavior: May render as a collapsible bottom/side sheet

semantic_action: Clear selection; begin viewport pan without editing composition
pointer_interaction: Click/tap clears; primary-pointer drag or Space+drag pans; wheel/trackpad zooms
keyboard_interaction: Focus canvas for instructions; Escape cancels gesture; toolbar provides keyboard zoom/fit
disabled_condition: INITIALIZING or EXPORTING snapshot capture
error_state: Non-finite transform is rejected and last viewport retained
mobile_narrow_behavior: Consumes touch Pointer Events without removing button alternatives

semantic_action: Select and reposition one visible dataset entity in local world coordinates
keyboard_interaction: Tab focuses; Enter/Space selects; Arrow moves 10 world units; Shift+Arrow moves 1
disabled_condition: Node unavailable, hidden, INITIALIZING, or EXPORTING snapshot capture
error_state: Invalid movement is rejected; node returns to last finite position
mobile_narrow_behavior: Touch Pointer Events supported; inspector may become bottom sheet

semantic_action: Select and inspect one existing dataset-backed connection
keyboard_interaction: Tab to accessible target; Enter/Space selects
disabled_condition: Connection endpoint hidden or source connection unavailable
error_state: Stale target clears safely; no edge mutation action appears
mobile_narrow_behavior: Larger transparent hit target; equivalent list remains operable
